title: ipomoea pedicellata
intro: Ipomoea pedicellata, commonly known as Convolvulus pedicellatus, is a plant species in the Convolvulaceae family. This plant is known for its use in traditional medicine, particularly in Ayurvedic and Unani practices, where it is valued for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Ipomoea pedicellata include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in treating conditions such as fever, headache, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
